elements.requirement: In this Part, a domestic abuse protection order is an order made for the purpose of preventing a person ("P") from being abusive towards a person aged 16 or over to whom P is personally connected, which prohibits P from doing things described in the order or requires P to do things described in the order.
elements.quote: for the purpose of preventing a person (“P”) from being abusive towards a person aged 16 or over to whom P is personally connected

elements.requirement: A domestic abuse protection order may be made either on application (under section 28) or in the course of certain proceedings (under section 31).
elements.quote: A domestic abuse protection order may be made— (a) on application (see section 28), or (b) in the course of certain proceedings (see section 31).

elements.requirement: The conditions for making a domestic abuse protection order are set out in section 32.
elements.quote: Section 32 sets out the conditions for making a domestic abuse protection order.

thresholds.what: minimum age of the person to whom P is personally connected in order for a domestic abuse protection order to prevent P from being abusive towards them
